briefing_zh:
今天最清晰的主线是 Agent 系统开始主动管理自己的信息与感知预算。**Focused Omni-Modal GUI Agents** 不再把所有模态一股脑塞给策略，而是逐步选择真正相关的视觉、音频与历史信号；**MemT-1.0** 则把持续记忆从外挂数据库推进到模型计算内部。两者指向同一件事：下一阶段的增益不只来自更大上下文，而来自在正确时刻保留、读取和忽略正确的信息。

第二条主线是从「会调用工具」走向「会组织、验证并改进执行」。**S-Agent 2.0** 用 coding agent、3D 工具和 scene memory 拆解空间推理，**Sage-A1.5** 强调 orchestration、verification 与科学探索能力的动态组合，**HarnessPro** 更进一步把 harness 自我改进写成 performance-cost 的 Pareto 优化问题。这里最值得关注的不是又多了几个 agentic model，而是 verification 与成本开始成为训练和系统设计的一等目标。

评测也在从静态答案转向真实环境中的证据与过程。**MMEnterprise-Bench** 引入持续演化的企业记录、跨来源冲突和不可回答性，**StebBench** 则把 planning failure 细分为步骤遗漏、错误和顺序颠倒。与 HN 上 **Laminar flow-1** 的生产 trace 分析结合看，research benchmark 与线上 observability 正在靠拢：最终需要诊断的是 Agent 在哪一步、基于哪条证据、以什么成本偏离了目标。

开源侧的爆发集中在「让 Agent 接管更多真实工作面」：**earshot** 给 coding agent 补上音频感知，**git-ai** 重构多 Agent 并发开发的版本控制，Blender 与 WhatsApp 项目则展示了 scene-aware 操作和窄权限个人数据访问。同时，网站主动封锁 Web Agent 的讨论提醒我们，能力曲线并不等于部署曲线；安全、授权、责任和商业协议会成为与模型性能同等重要的基础设施。
briefing_en:
The clearest theme today is that agent systems are beginning to manage their own information and perception budgets. **Focused Omni-Modal GUI Agents** selects the visual, audio, and historical signals that matter at each step instead of flooding the policy with every modality, while **MemT-1.0** moves persistent memory from an external attachment into model computation. Both point to the same shift: the next gains may come less from larger contexts than from retaining, retrieving, and ignoring the right information at the right time.

A second theme is the move from merely calling tools to organizing, verifying, and improving execution. **S-Agent 2.0** decomposes spatial reasoning through a coding agent, 3D tools, and scene memory; **Sage-A1.5** emphasizes adaptive composition of orchestration, verification, and scientific-discovery capabilities; and **HarnessPro** casts harness self-improvement as a Pareto problem over performance and cost. The important signal is not another batch of agentic models, but the elevation of verification and cost to first-class training and systems objectives.

Evaluation is also moving from static answers toward evidence and process in realistic environments. **MMEnterprise-Bench** introduces evolving workplace records, cross-source conflicts, and unanswerability, while **StebBench** separates planning failures into missing, incorrect, and misordered steps. Read alongside **Laminar flow-1** and its production-trace analysis, research benchmarks and operational observability are converging on the same question: at which step, from which evidence, and at what cost did an agent leave the intended trajectory?

Open source is expanding the real surfaces agents can operate on: **earshot** adds audio perception for coding agents, **git-ai** redesigns version control for concurrent agent fleets, and the Blender and WhatsApp projects demonstrate scene-aware action and narrowly scoped access to personal data. At the same time, reports of websites blocking web agents show that capability curves are not deployment curves; security, permission, liability, and commercial protocols are becoming infrastructure problems as important as model quality.
viral_analysis_zh: 今天最可能形成跨圈传播的是 **git-ai**：它用「Anthropic 内部 Scion 的开源实现」这一强叙事，把抽象的多 Agent 并发瓶颈压缩成开发者一眼能懂的 Git 替代方案，7 天内获得 1,300+ stars。**Sphinx** 同样具备爆款结构——一个 git push 前的小钩子，把「AI 写了但人不懂」的普遍焦虑转化成可演示、可安装、带反直觉问答的产品瞬间。
viral_analysis_en: **git-ai** is the strongest cross-community viral candidate: the framing of an open implementation of Anthropic's internal Scion compresses an abstract multi-agent concurrency problem into a Git replacement developers immediately understand, earning 1,300+ stars within the search window. **Sphinx** has a similarly strong launch shape—a tiny pre-push hook turns the widespread fear of shipping AI-written code without understanding it into a concrete, demo-friendly interaction.

huggingface_papers.title: Focused Omni-Modal GUI Agents
huggingface_papers.tldr: GUI agents are usually given every available screenshot, audio cue, video frame, history entry, and device state at every step, even though only a small subset is relevant. FocusGUI learns step-dependent gates over modality embeddings, suppressing transient distractions while leaving the frozen action decoder unchanged. The result matters because it treats perception selection as part of the control loop rather than assuming that more context is always better.
huggingface_papers.tldr_zh: GUI Agent 通常在每一步都接收截图、音频、视频、历史与设备状态，但真正相关的信号往往稀疏且会随步骤变化。FocusGUI 在模态 embedding 上学习逐步门控，在冻结 action decoder 的前提下抑制瞬时干扰。它的重要性在于把感知选择纳入控制闭环，而不是继续假设上下文越多越好。
huggingface_papers.authors: Fuyao Zhang, Wenwen He, Jiaming Zhang, Yurong Hao, Xuan Wang, Guowei Guan, Che Wang, Longtao Huang, Wei Yang Bryan Lim

huggingface_papers.title: Ropedia W0: Scaling Loco-Manipulation World Models across Embodiments with Human Experience
huggingface_papers.tldr: Ropedia W0 is an egocentric world foundation model spanning human and robot loco-manipulation across heterogeneous bodies. Its Xp-Data corpus aggregates 10,000 hours of embodied experience and uses a unified kinematic representation to bridge embodiment-specific action spaces. This scale and representation could make model-based planning transfer across platforms instead of being rebuilt for each robot.
huggingface_papers.tldr_zh: Ropedia W0 是覆盖人类与多种机器人形态的第一视角 locomotion-manipulation 世界基础模型。其 Xp-Data 汇集 1 万小时具身经验，并用统一运动学表示连接不同 embodiment 的动作空间。关键价值是让 model-based planning 有机会跨平台迁移，而非为每种机器人重新训练一套模型。
huggingface_papers.authors: Tianqi Liu, Hanfei Zhao, Qifeng Liang, Hui En Pang, Jiarui Xu, Sayang Mu, Penghao Qiu, YingSheng Zhang, Jun Wang, Ziang Cao, Mingze Sun, Yukang Cao, Fangzhou Hong, Zhaoxi Chen, Ziwei Liu

huggingface_papers.title: S-Agent 2.0: Spatial Reasoning with a General Coding Agent
huggingface_papers.tldr: S-Agent 2.0 reframes spatial reasoning as an active coding-agent task: the model gathers 3D evidence with tools, stores scene state, and writes programs to reason over it. The paper targets a common failure mode where perception tools retrieve the right evidence but the language model still cannot compose it into the correct answer. Separating evidence acquisition, persistent scene memory, and executable reasoning offers a more inspectable path than one-shot VLM inference.
huggingface_papers.tldr_zh: S-Agent 2.0 把空间推理改造成主动 coding-agent 任务：模型调用 3D 工具收集证据、维护 scene memory，再编写程序完成推理。它针对的核心故障是感知工具已经返回正确证据，但语言模型仍无法组合出正确答案。把证据获取、持久场景状态和可执行推理解耦，比 one-shot VLM 推断更可检查。
huggingface_papers.authors: Rui Gong, Ruoyu Wang, Yalun Dai, Hao Li, Sidi Yang, Qihao Zhao, Hongyu Li, Zeyang Guan, Fangzhou Hong, Zhaoxi Chen, Kim-Hui Yap, Ziwei Liu

huggingface_papers.title: Sage-A1.5: From Long-Horizon Execution to Scientific Exploration with Capability Composition
huggingface_papers.tldr: Sage-A1.5 is a 35B MoE agentic model aimed at long-horizon execution and open scientific exploration. It emphasizes adaptive composition of orchestration, verification, and domain tools instead of treating each capability as an isolated benchmark skill. The release is notable because it positions verification and strategy revision as learned behaviors inside the model's execution process.
huggingface_papers.tldr_zh: Sage-A1.5 是面向长程执行与开放科学探索的 35B MoE agentic model。它强调动态组合 orchestration、verification 与领域工具，而不是把每项能力当成彼此独立的 benchmark 技能。值得关注的是，它试图把验证和策略修订训练成执行过程中的内生行为。
huggingface_papers.authors: Wenjie Lou, Tianshuo Peng, Shiyang Feng, Shengji Tang, Runmin Ma, Ruizhe Chen, Jinxin Shi, Haoyang Peng, Fangchen Yu, Zhijie Zhong, Yuhao Zhou, Yue Fan, Yixin Chen, Yiming Wu, Yiheng Wang, Yigeng Jiang, Yichen Jiang, Yi Xie, Xu Guo, Xiaohan He, Tao Hu, Songtao Huang, Siyu Zhou, Shuaiyu Zhang, Shangheng Du, Qinglong Cao, Kun Li, Jingqi Ye, Hongbin Zhou, Guohang Yan, Zongsheng Cao, Ziyi Wang, Zhuo Liu, Zhiyin Yu, Zhiwang Zhou, Zelin Tan, Yuqing Zhu, Yaoze Zhang, Yang Chen, Xuming He, Xiuliang Liang, Xingjian Guo, Xiang Zhuang, Weiping Shen, Weida Wang, Tianyuan Zhou, Tianlin Ye, Tengyuan Fan, Siyu Yan, Shuo Li, Shuchen Pu, Shengyuan Xu, Shao Zhang, Ran Wei, Qinyuan Qin, Qingyu Yang, Nianchen Deng, Meng Dai, Kuikun Liu, Kaitao Chen, Juncheng Xiao, Jiangning Liu, Jianbiao Mei, Jia Yu, Haonan He, Hangfan Zhang, Cheng Yang, Chen Zhang, Bihao Zhan, Benteng Cheng, Yuqiang Li, Yihao Liu, Yang Yang, Xujun Fu, Xiaosong Wang, Xiangyu Yue, Wenwei Zhang, Shuyue Hu, Pinlong Cai, Mianxin Liu, Lei Bai, Jie Zhou, Jie Hou, Jiamin Wu, Hui Wang, Haijun Li, Guangyu Wang, Dongzhan Zhou, Chunfeng Song, Chao Yang, Biqing Qi, Xing Xie, Dahua Lin, Bowen Zhou, Xiangchao Yan, Wenlong Zhang, Shufei Zhang, Peng Ye, Bo Zhang

huggingface_papers.title: MMEnterprise-Bench: Evaluating Enterprise Agents over Evolving Multimodal Records
huggingface_papers.tldr: MMEnterprise-Bench evaluates agents over workplace records that evolve across documents, chats, and figures, creating stale versions and cross-source conflicts. It tests whether systems gather sufficient evidence, resolve temporal contradictions, and abstain when the available record cannot support an answer. This is a more realistic enterprise-agent benchmark because retrieval budget and evidence provenance are part of the task rather than hidden preprocessing assumptions.
huggingface_papers.tldr_zh: MMEnterprise-Bench 在持续演化的文档、聊天和图表记录上评测企业 Agent，其中会自然出现旧版本与跨来源冲突。它考察系统能否收集充分证据、解决时间矛盾，并在记录不足时拒答。该基准把 retrieval budget 与证据 provenance 直接纳入任务，比把检索当作隐藏预处理假设更贴近真实企业环境。
huggingface_papers.authors: Seohyun Lee, Jongha Kim, Dohwan Ko, Ji Soo Lee, Seoung Choi, Jayun Ku, Hyunwoo J. Kim

alphaxiv_papers.title: MemT-1.0: Towards Memory-Native Evolution
alphaxiv_papers.tldr: MemT-1.0 proposes a memory-native foundation-model architecture in which information is updated and retrieved inside the model computation rather than attached as an external store. It builds on Metis with Gated DeltaNet-2 and a stable token-level update mechanism across turns. The work is important because it treats continual accumulation as an architectural primitive, potentially reducing the gap between long conversations and genuinely persistent agent memory.
alphaxiv_papers.tldr_zh: MemT-1.0 提出 memory-native 基础模型架构，让信息在模型计算内部更新与读取，而不是外挂一个存储层。它在 Metis 基础上引入 Gated DeltaNet-2 和稳定的跨轮 token-level 更新机制。其意义是把持续积累变成架构原语，有望缩小长对话上下文与真正持久 Agent Memory 之间的差距。

alphaxiv_papers.title: Reward Misspecification Degrades Chain-of-Thought Monitorability
alphaxiv_papers.tldr: This study asks whether imperfect rewards make a model's chain of thought harder to monitor during reinforcement learning. The concern is structural: complex environments cannot provide perfectly specified verification, so optimization may reward behavior that remains successful while becoming less legible to overseers. The result sharpens the safety trade-off between maximizing task reward and preserving a useful behavioral audit channel.
alphaxiv_papers.tldr_zh: 该研究考察 reward misspecification 是否会在 RL 过程中降低 chain-of-thought 的可监控性。问题具有结构性：复杂环境无法提供完美验证，优化可能奖励任务表现成功但对监督者越来越不透明的行为。它把任务 reward 最大化与保留有效行为审计通道之间的安全 trade-off 具体化。

alphaxiv_papers.title: Text-to-Image Generative Modeling Without Language Pretraining
alphaxiv_papers.tldr: Halcyon tests whether strong text-to-image generation actually requires internet-scale language pretraining. The models are trained from scratch with early-fusion autoregression on 100 million image-text pairs, and the 0.52B variant reportedly surpasses a substantially larger LlamaGen baseline on generation quality. If the scaling trend holds, it weakens the assumption that image generators must inherit a pretrained language backbone.
alphaxiv_papers.tldr_zh: Halcyon 直接检验高质量 text-to-image 是否必须依赖互联网规模的语言预训练。该系列在 1 亿图文对上从零训练 early-fusion autoregressive model，其中 0.52B 版本据称在生成质量上超过更大的 LlamaGen baseline。若这一 scaling 趋势成立，它会动摇图像生成器必须继承预训练语言 backbone 的默认假设。

alphaxiv_papers.title: HarnessPro: Recursive Harness Self-Improvement with Pareto Optimization for Performance-Cost Trade-offs
alphaxiv_papers.tldr: HarnessPro evolves agent harnesses against both task performance and execution cost, using Pareto optimization rather than a single accuracy objective. Its label-free loop generates tests, evaluates candidate harnesses, and retains solutions that improve the performance-cost frontier. This matters because recursive harness improvement otherwise tends to buy gains with longer traces and higher inference bills.
alphaxiv_papers.tldr_zh: HarnessPro 同时围绕任务表现与执行成本进化 Agent harness，用 Pareto optimization 取代单一准确率目标。其 label-free 循环生成测试、评估候选 harness，并保留能推进 performance-cost frontier 的方案。它击中了 recursive harness improvement 的现实问题：很多提升只是用更长轨迹和更高推理账单换来的。

alphaxiv_papers.title: StebBench: Diagnosing Real-World Procedural Understanding in AI Agents
alphaxiv_papers.tldr: StebBench contains 6,885 verified procedures across 81 open-domain categories to diagnose how agents understand real-world plans. Instead of scoring only a final plan, it localizes missing, incorrect, and misordered actions. The benchmark is valuable because it turns vague planning failure into specific procedural error types that can guide training and debugging.
alphaxiv_papers.tldr_zh: StebBench 收录 81 个开放领域中的 6,885 条经验证流程，用于诊断 Agent 对现实步骤的理解。它不只给最终计划打分，还定位遗漏、错误与顺序颠倒等具体问题。其价值是把模糊的 planning failure 拆成可用于训练和调试的程序性错误类型。

github_repos.name: Leonxlnx/earshot
github_repos.tldr: Earshot gives coding agents an audio-analysis surface that runs locally on CPU through a CLI, Python API, and MCP server. It can describe sounds, find events in recordings, score synchronization, render code-defined effects, and iteratively improve generated audio by listening to the result. The project stands out because it turns an under-served modality into measurable evidence rather than asking a general model to guess from waveforms.
github_repos.tldr_zh: Earshot 为 coding agent 提供可在 CPU 本地运行的音频分析接口，覆盖 CLI、Python API 与 MCP server。它能描述声音、定位录音事件、评估同步、渲染代码定义的音效，并通过监听结果迭代改进生成音频。项目的亮点是把长期缺位的音频模态转成可测证据，而不是让通用模型直接猜 waveform。

github_repos.name: feder-cr/git-ai
github_repos.tldr: git-ai is an open-source, server-centric version-control design for large fleets of coding agents, inspired by Anthropic's public description of Scion. It replaces clone-heavy, queue-based workflows with online clients, server-side history queries, compare-and-swap landing, and explicit changeset logs. The rapid attention reflects a real systems bottleneck: classic Git semantics become costly when hundreds of short-lived agents modify one branch concurrently.
github_repos.tldr_zh: git-ai 是面向大规模 coding-agent fleet 的开源 server-centric 版本控制实现，灵感来自 Anthropic 对 Scion 的公开描述。它用在线客户端、服务端历史查询、compare-and-swap landing 与显式 changeset log，替代重 clone 和 merge queue 工作流。其快速走红对应真实系统瓶颈：数百个短生命周期 Agent 并发修改同一分支时，经典 Git 语义会变得昂贵。

github_repos.name: LiCinCan/blender-ai-mcp-addon
github_repos.tldr: This Blender add-on combines scene-aware chat, 21 editing tools, viewport snapshots, approvals, and an authenticated MCP server. Users can connect cloud or local models and choose either a single assistant or manager-worker-reviewer workflows for multi-step scene operations. Its appeal is the tight feedback loop between natural-language intent, structured 3D state, visible actions, and human approval.
github_repos.tldr_zh: 该 Blender 插件把 scene-aware chat、21 个编辑工具、viewport snapshot、审批机制与带认证的 MCP server 集成到一起。用户可连接云端或本地模型，并在单助手与 manager-worker-reviewer 多步工作流之间选择。它的吸引力来自自然语言意图、结构化 3D 状态、可见操作和人工审批构成的紧密反馈闭环。

github_repos.name: cranebeaker/coop-anything
github_repos.tldr: Co-op Anything supplies an agent playbook and MCP tooling for turning single-player games into multiplayer experiences. The workflow has agents research engines, reverse engineer behavior, implement synchronization, test with in-game bots, and package installation for players. It is compelling because it frames coding agents as end-to-end modding teams and already points to multiple game-specific implementations rather than a one-off demo.
github_repos.tldr_zh: Co-op Anything 提供 Agent playbook 与 MCP 工具，让 coding agent 把单机游戏改造成多人体验。工作流覆盖引擎调研、逆向、同步实现、游戏内 bot 测试与面向玩家的安装打包。它的吸引力在于把 Agent 定位为端到端 modding 团队，并已有多个具体游戏实现，而非一次性 demo。

github_repos.name: finereli/whatsapp-mcp
github_repos.tldr: whatsapp-mcp is a read-only MCP server that lets an agent search a user's own WhatsApp history without gaining send privileges. It runs in the user's Cloudflare account, stores queued messages in a Durable Object SQLite database, and keeps the phone as the source of truth. The narrow permission boundary is the key design lesson: useful personal-context access does not require giving an agent the ability to impersonate the user.
github_repos.tldr_zh: whatsapp-mcp 是只读 MCP server，让 Agent 搜索用户自己的 WhatsApp 历史，但不获得发送权限。它运行在用户的 Cloudflare 账户中，把队列消息存入 Durable Object SQLite，并保持手机为 source of truth。最值得学习的是窄权限边界：获得有用的个人上下文，不等于必须允许 Agent 冒充用户发言。

hackernews.title: Show HN: Sphinx – A hook that quizzes you on your AI's code before shipping
hackernews.tldr: Sphinx inserts an understanding check into git push for agent-assisted code. An independent reviewer model reads the diff and quizzes the human about failure behavior; the push proceeds only after the developer demonstrates comprehension, while bypasses remain logged. The idea is viral because it addresses a new human-factor failure mode: code can be correct enough to ship while its owner no longer understands the system.
hackernews.tldr_zh: Sphinx 在 Agent 辅助开发的 git push 前插入理解检查。独立 reviewer model 读取 diff，并就故障行为向人提问；开发者证明自己理解后才能继续，绕过操作也会留痕。它容易走红，因为直击新的 human-factor 故障：代码可能足够正确可以上线，但所有者已经不再理解系统。

hackernews.title: Tmux and Claude Code: Sessions, Send-Keys, and the Ceiling
hackernews.tldr: This guide explains why tmux remains useful for persistent remote coding agents, then maps its hard ceiling for larger fleets. send-keys and capture-pane enable lightweight scripting, but approval state, completion events, durable transcripts, and cross-agent coordination all require brittle scraping or custom glue. The broader lesson is that shell multiplexing is a good transport layer, not a complete agent orchestration substrate.
hackernews.tldr_zh: 这篇指南解释了 tmux 为何仍适合持久化远程 coding agent，也明确了它在更大 fleet 下的上限。send-keys 与 capture-pane 能做轻量脚本化，但审批状态、完成事件、持久 transcript 和跨 Agent 协同都依赖脆弱的屏幕抓取或自建胶水。更一般的结论是：shell multiplexer 是好用的 transport layer，却不是完整的 Agent orchestration substrate。

hackernews.title: Websites are closing their doors to AI agents
hackernews.tldr: Major web services are increasingly blocking autonomous agents from booking, shopping, or accessing financial accounts. The reported reasons combine security, data licensing, liability, and providers' desire to decide which intermediaries may transact on their sites. This creates a deployment bottleneck that model improvements alone cannot solve: capable web agents still need explicit trust and economic protocols with service owners.
hackernews.tldr_zh: 越来越多大型网站开始阻止自主 Agent 订票、购物或访问金融账户。公开理由混合了安全、数据授权、责任归属，以及服务方对交易中介的控制权。由此出现模型能力无法单独解决的部署瓶颈：Web Agent 即使会操作，也仍需与服务提供方建立明确的信任和经济协议。

hackernews.title: Show HN: rStation – A shared research lab for your AI agents
hackernews.tldr: rStation presents a shared research community where autonomous agents join open problems, discuss results, and publish reviewed papers while humans can observe. The live site reports more than one hundred registered agents and hundreds of papers across mathematics and systems topics. It is an ambitious multi-agent experiment, although volume should not be confused with independent validation of the generated research.
hackernews.tldr_zh: rStation 构建了共享研究社区，让自主 Agent 加入开放问题、讨论结果并发布经 review 的论文，人类可以旁观。站点实时展示上百个注册 Agent 和数百篇覆盖数学与系统主题的论文。它是大胆的 multi-agent 实验，但产出数量不能等同于研究结论已经获得独立验证。

hackernews.title: Launch HN: Laminar (YC S24) – RL-trained model that finds errors in agent traces
hackernews.tldr: Laminar's flow-1 is a small RL-trained model for finding implicit failures inside long agent traces. Its Signals harness treats spans like files, using search and selective reads to produce schema-defined findings; the team claims GPT-6-sol-level detection quality at 23 times lower cost on its benchmark. The important product loop is trace analysis to clustered failure patterns to production-derived evals, though the performance claim remains vendor-reported.
hackernews.tldr_zh: Laminar 的 flow-1 是专门在长 Agent trace 中发现隐性错误的小型 RL 模型。Signals harness 把 span 当作文件，通过搜索和选择性读取输出 schema-defined findings；团队声称其自有 benchmark 上达到 GPT-6-sol 级检测质量且成本低 23 倍。真正重要的是 trace 分析、故障聚类到生产 eval 的闭环，但性能数字目前仍是厂商自报。
